segments.name: Power
products: full balance of plant, upgrade, and service solutions
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and services gas, nuclear, hydro and steam power equipment and services for utilities, industry and governments.
segments.evidence: Our Power segment serves power generation, industrial, government, and other customers worldwide with products and services related to energy production.

segments.name: Wind
products: onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades
segments.description: Engineers, manufactures and commercializes onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades, and services wind fleets for wind power customers.
segments.evidence: Our Wind segment includes our wind generation technologies, inclusive of onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades.

segments.name: Electrification
segments.description: Provides grid, power conversion, software and solar and storage technologies that carry electricity from generation to the point of use.
segments.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025 , our Power Conversion and Solar & Storage Solutions business units within our Electrification segment were combined to form a new business unit, Power Conversion & Storage.
